description: Minimal server-rendered Python web app (standard-library HTTP server) with render tests but no browser test tooling

profile.PROJECT_NAME_AND_PURPOSE: team-portal: internal web portal for a small team's links and preferences
profile.PRIMARY_JOURNEYS: Open the home page; navigate between pages; change personal display preferences
profile.SCOPE: Included: server-rendered pages and preference forms. Excluded: authentication (behind the company proxy), external APIs
profile.TECHNOLOGY_STACK: Python 3.10+ standard library `http.server`; HTML rendered server-side; no JavaScript framework; no storage yet
profile.SUPPORTED_ENVIRONMENTS: Linux server with Python 3.10+; current stable Firefox and Chromium
profile.DATA_AND_TRUST_BOUNDARIES: Internal users behind the company proxy; preferences are non-sensitive; all request input is untrusted
profile.UI_TEST_COMMANDS_OR_JUSTIFIED_EXCLUSION: None configured yet (required at Internal tool tier)
